payload.claim: `tokens = _changed_lines(diff) - excluded_tokens` calls `_changed_lines`, which itself calls `_token_counts(diff)` again, even though `counts = _token_counts(diff)` was just computed two lines above at :274. The LCS pass over every file block (the expensive part size.py exists to bound with `_TOKEN_DIFF_BOUND`) now runs twice per `size_gate` call instead of once, with no behavioural difference since `sum(count for _, count, _ in counts) - excluded_tokens` would give the identical result. Trivial for the diffs in this repo's own test suite, but every production task and every PACKAGE re-verification now pays this twice.
